svg.title: How Codex works with NoDoc
svg.desc: On your computer, config.toml points Codex to the NoDoc MCP endpoint and names ASK_NODOC_MCP_TOKEN. Codex reads the personal token from that Windows user environment variable. The local nodoc-mcp skill provides workflow instructions. Codex sends an authenticated MCP request over HTTPS. NoDoc identifies the user and checks permissions for each action before accessing authorized content. Content results return through the MCP service to Codex, which can also receive an access error. For a page action, specify the focus area, article, page, and version. This is a conceptual flow, not a deployment diagram.
svg.text: Your configuration connects the tools. Your NoDoc permissions control access.

g.text: Stored in your Windows user variable
The token identifies you. It does not add permissions.
NoDoc checks your role, authorship, and content access for every action.

svg.text: Conceptual flow · No extra access is granted
